expectedIssues: Pizza category is selected but the feed still shows all cuisines
reportedIssues: The 'Pizza' filter chip is shown in the active/selected state, yet the content below is unfiltered: 'Fastest near you' shows Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria, and 'Popular right now' leads with Tokumaru Ramen Bar. Only the second popular card is pizza-related, so the selected filter appears not to be applied to the rendered results.

Inconsistent favorite (heart) button styling between cards: on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart sits directly on the image with no circular scrim, while the pizza card below uses a dark translucent circular background. On lighter image areas the un-backed icon would be hard to see.
The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is very light gray on a light gray fill, giving a low contrast ratio that is difficult to read for low-vision users.

Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards also show rating, ETA and cuisine. The missing rating/cuisine metadata makes the two rows feel inconsistent and gives users less information to compare options.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the selected Pizza filter failing to filter the displayed restaurant results.
